response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Mhuise, news? Aye, plenty. I heard Sean Ruadh Kelly goin' on about secret meetin's at the lime kiln, and himself the quietest man in the parish.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face

question: How does the harvest look this year?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Mhuise, we're only after puttin' the seed in this month past — Da says a wet March makes a fat autumn, and sure the ground's soft enough already. Were ye out along the bog road this mornin'? The furrows look grand.

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: *A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face wipes his hands on his apron and grins.*

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
response_lines.text: Da's grand — he's out back at the bellows there, and Ma's up at the house puttin' bread to rise. Sure we're all well enough, thanks be to God. And yerself — did ye come far this mornin'?

question: Is old Festus the cooper still at his shop by the bridge?

response_lines.text: Festus? I know no cooper of that name in these parts, and there's no shop by any bridge that I've seen — we've but the one mill and the forge for ironwork. Sure ye must be thinkin' of another parish entirely?

response_lines.speaker: A lanky red-haired lad with soot on his face
